curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with what rectangles, diamonds and pentagons tell you, then regulatory signs, speed limit signs and the wrong-way and one-way signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for vertical versus horizontal rectangles, fixed versus electronic limits, and wrong way versus one way.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on sign shapes and basic regulatory signs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the turn bans and the U-turn rule, Do Not Pass, Left Turn Yield on Green, Keep Right, lane use control, HOV and disabled parking signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for No Left Turn versus No U-Turn, No Turn on Red versus Left Turn Yield on Green, and lane use versus keep right arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps turn bans and lane signs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what warning signs ask of you, advisory and reduced speed signs, control-ahead signs, the No Passing Zone pennant, merges, lane reductions and divided highways.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for advisory versus reduced limit, merge versus lane reduction, and divided highway begins versus ends.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on warning signs for speed, controls and lanes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through slippery pavement, low clearance, hills and deer, buggies and farm equipment, and pedestrian, bicycle and school crossings.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for buggies versus farm equipment and for ordinary crossings versus school zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on road condition and crossing signs.
